headline: Funen man is charged with abusing 68 children online
headline_short: Man charged over abuse of 68 children
deck: He denies the charges; his trial opens on Tuesday and a verdict is expected in December.
standard: Prosecutors have charged a 25-year-old man from Funen, a Danish island, with grooming 68 children and with sextortion, in which an offender threatens to publish the victim's pictures or films. Most were between 11 and 14. He denies the charges. His trial opens on Tuesday in Svendborg, a town on Funen, and a verdict is expected in December.

According to the indictment, he contacted the children on Snapchat and OmeTV, which police call a chat roulette, and got them to perform sexual acts on themselves while he watched on screen. Police have identified 27 of the 68, most from Denmark. He has been in custody since March 2025.
short: A 25-year-old man from Funen, a Danish island, is charged with grooming and sextortion of 68 children, most of them aged 11 to 14. He denies the charges; his trial opens on Tuesday in Svendborg, a town on Funen.
